name: codex-agent-view
description: Follow Codex work and participating agent progress in a clear, read-only live view inside the official Codex app.

interface.longDescription: See active work, a privacy-minimized request summary, participating agents, and progress inside the official Codex app. Select the plugin first, then explicitly invoke the bundled $show-agents skill to open the live view; the plugin does not append or auto-run action text.
